messages.subject: multidimensional Rasch/PCM model
parts:
Hi Phil,

In the mirt manual, I didn't find examples that show how to fit a multidimensional Rasch (dichotomous) model or a multidimensional partial credit model to the data. The Rasch (dichotomous) and partial credit model are applied for unidimensional model only. All the multidimensional examples are either 2PL or 3PL model for dichotomous items and GPCM model for polytomous items. Can you give me an example for the command below when the dimensions are more than 1? Thanks a lot!

mirt(data, 1, itemtype='Rasch')

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: multidimensional Rasch/PCM model
parts:
Hi Jing,

There's several ways to do this, though perhaps the easiest is just to specify a mirt.model() definition and apply some equality constraints. For example, a multidimensional Rasch model could be expressed as 

model <- " F1 = 1-5
                 F2 = 6-10
                COV = F1*F2
                CONSTRAIN = (1-5, a1), (6-10, a2)"

mod <- mirt(data, model)

Rasch models are really just slope constrained 2PL models, so for multidimensional extensions you only need to constrain the slopes to be equal within each respective dimension. HTH.

Phil
